prompts.caption: Instrumental cinematic glitch-hop, electronic hip-hop and hybrid orchestral bass music with a playful, mischievous, dynamic and suspenseful mood. A syncopated lead motif in D minor uses short call-and-response phrases between a glitched synthesizer and staccato orchestral accents such as brass and strings. The arrangement moves from the main theme into a contrasting breakdown before a denser melodic return with layered leads. Punchy halftime drums, controlled sub bass, micro-edited glitch cuts and wide cinematic reverb shape the production.
